item.tib: dpal ldan bla ma'i gsol 'debs shel dkar phreng ba
item.coloph: ces skye gnas kha brgyud dpag med yongs 'khyams la/ rnam thar skyes phreng brjod na bsam mi khyab/ ngag 'chal gsol 'debs brjod par mi 'os kyang / gang zag gzhan gyis mthong na ngo re tsha/ 'on kyang dad ldan zhu ba blo tshim chad/ sa gsum rig 'dzin smon lam rgyal mtshan dang / me sras rnam rol gar dbang bdud 'dul sogs/ mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan 'ga' yis zhal gsung dang / rang gi nyin 'khrul rmi lam 'ga' la yang / bag chags rab rib 'khrul ba'i snang cha la/ gzhir byas ngag 'chal 'bol tshig smra ba yin/ 'on kyang rang bstod rang gis ma lags te/ dad ldan grogs po bka' slob snying gi bu/ rig kyi gnas lnga'i zlos gar mi rmongs pa'i/ rigs mthun btsun pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis/ rten 'brel zab mo shel dkar phreng ba dang / dri med lha rdzas chun pos sna drangs nas/ skyes rabs gsol 'debs bgyis dgos bka' yis bskul/ zhu ba blo tshim skyes rabs yin tshul ba/ 'chal tshig tho co kho nar smra ba 'di/ rgod rje'i rus thob drung mu'i ming can des/ dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod du/ bgyis pa 'dis kyang 'gro rnams myur bsgrod shog/
